chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer except with one Takbir, unless he has previously prayed another prayer.
So if he prays another prayer, the first Takbir is valid for him.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَة: The act of saying 'Allahu Akbar' (God is Greater), specifically the opening declaration in prayer

ai.seo_question: How many Takbirs are required for each prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (AS) clarification on the necessity of repeating the opening Takbir for distinct prayer units, establishing a key principle in Shia jurisprudence regarding the validity of *Salat*. This ruling distinguishes between continuous prayer sessions and separate acts of worship, ensuring the ritual integrity of each unit. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on precise adherence to the Prophet’s and Imams’ instructions in maintaining the spiritual and legal correctness of daily prayers.
